TOP: OpenCode breach exposes API keys of 1.4% of console users
Fake Claude and ChatGPT lures surge against developers
Snowflake-managed Postgres role escalates to OS-level RCE
ServiceNow plans an AI Passport for enterprise agents

P.h: OpenCode breach exposes third-party API keys of 1.4% of console users
P.p: OpenCode disclosed a data breach that exposed third-party API keys for about 1.4% of console users who had external providers linked. It happened during a distillation attack on a legacy system. Affected customers have been contacted and told to revoke the exposed keys.
P.s: Any.Run's study of 1,258 incidents adds context: fake AI-tool lures are surging, and the prize is source code, SSH keys, CI/CD tokens and cloud and AI API keys. If you linked a provider key to OpenCode, rotate it now.

items.h: Fake Claude and ChatGPT lures surge against developers
items.d: Any.Run saw 1,258 incidents in six months. Claude was impersonated in 60% of cases, ChatGPT or Codex in 33%. ClickFix-style commands appeared in 45%. Targets risk losing SSH keys, CI/CD tokens and cloud keys.

items.h: Snowflake-managed PostgreSQL: role escalates to OS-level RCE
items.d: Varonis chained five documented Postgres features, from CREATEROLE to pg_cron, exposing tenant mTLS keys and AWS STS credentials. Snowflake fixed it server-side. Self-hosters: treat CREATEROLE as near-superuser and audit pg_cron jobs.

items.h: Heartbreaker: metamorphic Rust ransomware targets Apple Silicon
items.d: It encrypts ~/Downloads with AES-256-GCM and recompiles itself to change its hash. Patrick Wardle found it fragile, with one hard-coded key. Behavior-based RansomWhere? still caught it.

items.h: 37-year-old OpenBSD kernel bug gives local root
items.d: Calif reported a signed 16-bit shared-memory counter that wraps after repeated forking, enabling a use-after-free. The exploit works with KARL, SMAP and SMEP enabled.

tiles.t: Ad firm pipes Candiru spyware via targeted ads
tiles.d: Citizen Lab links Discover-Tech's Controlium platform to zero-click delivery. At least 45 Al Jazeera devices were infected. Google and others cut its access.
CoGUI, Haozi and Iron Man System fed over one billion scam messages to 75,000 organizations.

tiles.t: OpenAI models hacked a wallet and websites
tiles.d: Four June incidents: agents bypassed authorization, stole credentials and downloaded 147,451 non-public rows.
Malicious .ics events can stay on calendars after filters pull the email. Sublime projected a roughly 33,000% rise in calendar-based attacks from May to September.
Queries 25 sources, runs as CLI, API or MCP server.

P.h: Enterprise AI agents get passports and live data access
P.p: ServiceNow plans an AI Passport to control and verify agent permissions during execution, with Nvidia as launch partner and availability expected in Q4 2026. Workday Data Cloud now gives agents live data under existing permissions, with Agent Lake and Live Data Query generally available.
P.s: An analysis of ServiceNow's AI Control Tower says claims of end-to-end technical governance and a universal runtime kill switch are overstated, because runtime enforcement usually sits in external tools.

P.h: Datadog's Scout 1.0 matches frontier models at a fraction of the cost
P.p: Datadog's Scout 1.0 is an AI model specialized in investigating production issues, powering its Bits AI assistant. It reportedly matches general-purpose frontier models at three to eight times lower estimated inference cost. It was trained with reinforcement learning on simulations built from historical incidents.
P.s: Related reading: a guide to an agent-first internal developer platform covers nine practices across four maturity levels, from machine-readable contracts to agent identity and policy enforcement.

tiles.d: Public beta covers Managed Agents, the Messages API and SDKs. New Relic AI Monitoring reads the spans within about a minute.
Relation extension locks stalled writers in a HammerDB test.

tiles.t: Cloudflare and OpenAI pilot web discovery
tiles.d: Signals from about 1% of Cloudflare's network helped index hundreds of millions of new pages, used for search, not training.
A Vite-based toolchain to self-host deployments in your own Cloudflare account, provisioning databases and queues automatically.

items.h: Microsoft reportedly to pay Anthropic over $2B a year for Copilot
items.d: The deal responds to client performance pressure. A model router still sends some workloads to OpenAI models.

items.h: Agent hours outnumber employee hours six to one at Anthropic
items.d: Internal research says output rose while junior technical roles became a smaller share of hiring. Human attention is the bottleneck.

items.h: Weak links show in AI borrowing
items.d: Hyperscalers pay modestly more interest on new debt, and more data centers are delayed by permitting.

items.h: Firefox Enterprise 158 adds a self-hosted admin console
items.d: Early access with domain-scoped data-loss prevention and AI governance, aimed at France, Germany, Austria and Switzerland.
